title: Our Story
slide_intent: Use a distinct chapter opening to signal the start of the brand’s historical premise, helping readers keep the kinds of guidance apart.
strategic_value: The repeated display style can make our story feel part of one Burger King document.
demonstration: A large Our Story title sits on a flat field with small running labels and notices.
practical_value: Use this divider to identify where our story guidance begins without interpreting it as a standalone application rule.

content_islands.name: Chapter title
content_islands.spec: Place the oversized Our Story title at upper left, brown on orange, leaving an open field below.

content_islands.name: Navigation and notices
content_islands.spec: Retain the small top navigation, page number and bottom publication notice.

reference_purposes.Expression: The Our Story divider uses large rounded display type and the warm brown on orange treatment.
